patch_description: Make the true Heilbronn objective—the smallest of the 286 triangle areas—the primary acceptance criterion during the global coordinate search. The existing LogSumExp soft-min can select a candidate with a better average lower tail while sacrificing the actual smallest triangle, which is directly detrimental to the evaluated score. This edit first maximizes the exact candidate minimum area, then uses the soft bottleneck only to break numerically meaningful near-ties. This retains the useful global-shaping behavior of the smooth surrogate without permitting it to trade away the hard bottleneck.
